entry_gate: high-priority pair with independent replication class REPLICATED; pair family and full-resolution inputs must be checksum-locked before PLACO+ result access
input_scope: genome-wide harmonized summary statistics for both traits; candidate-variant-only PLACO+ is prohibited

variant_harmonization.effect_allele: identical effect allele and strand across both traits
variant_harmonization.large_effect_sensitivity: variants excluded because either Z squared exceeds 80 remain in a separate two-trait genome-wide-significance screen

nuisance_estimation.correlation_policy: estimate from the full eligible genome-wide variant set; account for correlated Z statistics and sample overlap

multiplicity.primary_locked_family_threshold: 5e-8 divided by the number of pair scans frozen in the pleiotropy manifest
multiplicity.conjunction_fdr: optional sensitivity only when assumptions and exact tested family are documented; never substitute for PLACO+ primary results

locus_policy: define independent loci after the variant scan using a checksum-locked ancestry-matched LD reference; retain lead SNP, locus bounds, all significant variants, and clumping parameters
required_interpretation: PLACO+ identifies statistical association of a variant with both traits but cannot distinguish biological, horizontal, or vertical/mediated pleiotropy and does not prove a shared causal variant
